step_5_decide.rationale: Delivered 1 day ago (within 14-day window). Defective claim backed by photo on file. Amount $79.99 is within $100 auto-approval cap. Payment captured. Zero fraud risk.

title: Disputed Delivery with Verified OTP (ESCALATE)
customer_message: Where is my gaming laptop (Order ORD-9023)? Your tracking says delivered, but I NEVER got it! If you don't refund my $899 right now, I'm calling my lawyer and reporting you to the consumer bureau!

reasoning_trace.step_2_context: Order ORD-9023 exists in customer profile. 1 refund issued in past 30 days.

step_3_verify.discrepancy: Customer claims non-delivery, but carrier recorded delivery with OTP authentication at delivery address.

step_5_decide.rationale: High-severity triggers: (1) Claim discrepancy: customer claims non-delivery but OTP was verified at door. (2) Amount ($899.00) exceeds $100 cap. (3) Customer invoked legal and regulatory action. Autonomous agent is strictly forbidden from issuing refunds in this state.

args.audit_summary: Claim mismatch: Customer denies receiving ORD-9023 ($899.00), but delivery records confirm one-time passcode verification at recipient residence.

step_8_finalize.customer_response: I understand your concern regarding order #ORD-9023. Our delivery records indicate that the courier completed handover using the security verification code sent to your registered phone. Because of this verification record and the high-value nature of the item, I have escalated your file to our Senior Support and Delivery Investigation Team (Reference #TICK-ESC-9081). A specialist will review the GPS logs and reach out to you directly within 2 hours.

title: Missing Order ID & Multiple Candidates (ASK)

step_8_finalize.customer_response: I would be happy to assist with updating your shipping address. You have two recent orders on file: (1) #ORD-1102 - Ceramic Cookware Set (Sept 28) and (2) #ORD-1289 - Stainless Steel Blender (Oct 01). Which order would you like to update?
